messages:
anya: Quick sync — final notes from the GPTQ curation/bakeoff across Llama / Mistral / Qwen. Uploaded full artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/gptq/curation/17955. Short summary below, happy to follow up on any model+quant combo.

anya: TL;DR: GPTQ-4 toggles give the best cost/latency tradeoff overall but a couple of QA suites show small accuracy drops on Mistral and Qwen in reasoning-heavy prompts. AWQ-int8 looked promising for Qwen-7B (near-zero delta) but latency variability is worse on our shared infra.

anya: Key numbers (median over eval shards):
- llama-2-13b + GPTQ-4: EM delta -0.6%, perplexity +0.9, median token latency +18ms
- mistral-7b + GPTQ-4: EM delta -1.9%, long-form reasoning F1 -2.8pts, latency +22ms
- qwen-7b + AWQ-int8: EM delta -0.2%, latency +35ms (high variance), token cost ~0.44x fp16
- qwen-7b + GPTQ-4: EM delta -0.9%, latency +16ms

anya: Notes on evals: used our standard QA + reasoning + summarization slices (10k prompts, seeded sampling). Weight-tied tasks (multi-turn QA) show the biggest delta. Full csvs in s3.

cheng: Nice summary. For the Mistral -1.9% hit, is that concentrated on math/reasoning or also on factual QA?

anya: mostly reasoning/math and long-chain instructions. Factual single-turn QA was ~-0.4% only. See shard breakdown at s3 path: s3://redwood-evals/gptq/curation/17955/shards/mistral-7b.csv

mike: config we used for GPTQ-4 (repro):
```
quant: gptq
bits: 4
group_size: 128
act_order: false
percdamp: 0.01
```
Use batch=8, max_new_tokens=256 for eval jobs.

mike: AWQ-int8 configs varied, we pinned group_size=256 and used outlier-clipping. Will share config file in the artifact bundle.

eva: Curious about production impact: what did p99 latency look like on dedicated pools vs hosted (shared)? Any OOMs during load tests?

mike: p99 on dedicated (NVIDIA H100) for GPTQ-4 + llama-2-13b was ~210ms per token on our test rig; hosted (multi-tenant A100) saw p99 spikes to 520ms under synthetic bursts. No OOMs when using kv-cache sharding + continuous batching; had to reduce batch>16 on hosted.

sam: rollout plan suggestion: start with Qwen-7B AWQ-int8 on dedicated Dedicated customers (can opt-in) for 2 weeks canary, watch regression alerts on the reasoning suite. If stable, expand to hosted but with auto-fallback to fp16 variant on >0.8% EM regression.

anya: Agreed. Also add a local eval hook in console that runs the 500-shot reasoning subset before promoting model; failure threshold = -1.5% EM.

ci-bot: [ci] perf-check jobs completed: 17955-gptq-curation: 42/42 passed, 3 flaky jobs noted (AWQ p99 variance). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/17955

cheng: One more ask — can we run a small GPTQ-4 sweep with act_order=true and group_size=64 on the mistral-7b shard where it regressed? Might recover a bit.

anya: Good call. I'll queue that sweep — scheduling it overnight. Will post a follow-up thread with the delta table. :eyes:
